_about: Gathering (scripts/camp/camp_gather.gd). Each choppable scenery tree (models in trees.models) gives wood_per_tree wood, one per chop, then falls: a stump (stump_model) stays and a sapling (sapling_item, drawn as sapling_model) drops beside it at sapling_offset [x, z] metres. A sapling planted at a bare stump grows back into the tree after grow_days mornings. A chop takes chop_s while the tree wobbles (wobble_deg, wobble_s); a player works within reach_m of a tree's trunk. Forage spots refill each morning: each has an item, a model drawn while it is there, a spot [x, z] in metres and from_day (a day number) it first appears. A chop pops one wood_item out of the tree onto the grass (drops), and a forage spot's item goes into the Pack (data/items.json); with a full Pack the item stays on its spot. drops: a piece of wood (or a sapling) that pops out starts start_y_m up the trunk and lands land_m from the tree, turned spread_deg (then twice that) either side of the way to the chopper in turn, flying for pop_s up to pop_height_m with a bounce_m hop on landing. It lies there as a loose bundle until a player walks within sweep_m of it (after sweep_wait_s, so it lands first): then it flies into their Pack over fly_s, with a +N tag rising rise_m for tag_s. A full Pack leaves it on the grass (never lost). fall: a felled tree tips over fall.deg degrees in fall_s, away from the nearest camper, then shows only its stump. hit: on each chop or dig the tree or stump puffs puff_count felt bits of puff_swatch (palette) from crown_y_m up its trunk (stump_swatch from a stump) for puff_s. dig: with the shovel, a bare stump (or one whose sapling still lies there, which pops out too) is dug up over dig_s into a hole (hole_model) and pops roots_wood wood; a sapling planted in the hole grows back like one planted at a stump, and a hole left empty is grass the next morning, its spot free to build on (the tree is gone for good). long_log: each morning while the camp has none, a long log (model, carried like a chair) lies at pos [x, z] turned yaw degrees. Carried alone it goes at alone_speed of walking pace; with the other player within help_m it goes at full pace. Set down within fire_m of a fire_model in the clearing it splits into wood in the camp box (data/items.json).
